name: Kira Dog
lore: A route hound raised among ash couriers, Kira finds the living trail through wreckage and meets whatever follows it with a hooked blade.

abilities.name: Houndblade Charge
abilities.text: Once per turn, add +1 Grit to the first battle you start.

abilities.name: Ash-Scent Tracker
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Guile on non-blue Hazard tests.
